recordings.title: Find who owns any application in seconds
recordings.message: One true list of every application you run, with its owner and its stage.
recordings.summary: Opens the application portfolio, where every application shows its owner, lifecycle stage and the capability it supports. Typing a name narrows the list to that application, with its owner on the row.

recordings.title: Open a canvas already filled from your own model
recordings.message: Strategy canvases that fill themselves from what you already model.
recordings.summary: Opens the canvas library and one canvas whose boxes are already filled with partners, activities, resources, value propositions and customers taken from the organisation's own model. Every entry is an element of that model and opens from the canvas.
captions: Open a canvas already filled from your own model
Every box is made of elements your team already modelled, so nothing is typed twice
Partners, activities, resources, offer and customers, each one a real element of the model
Every entry opens the model element behind it, so the canvas and the model never disagree

recordings.title: See which controls apply to which applications, and where they stand
recordings.message: Show an auditor which controls cover which systems, in one place.
recordings.summary: Opens the regulatory compliance dashboard, which counts the adopted frameworks, their controls and the applications they are mapped to. Choosing a control from the findings opens it with the applications that carry it and whether each is planned, implemented or verified.
captions: See which controls apply to which applications, and where they stand
97 controls across 3 frameworks, mapped to the applications that carry them
Each control lists its applications and whether it is implemented, verified or planned
10 applications are mapped to this control, each with its own status

recordings.summary: Opens the digital twin on Calibration Ledger, the most connected system in the model, with its elements and relationships spread over the business, application and technology layers. The connections open as a list that names each one, from one element to the next.

recordings.title: See which risk would hit the most of your estate
recordings.message: Know which risk reaches the most of what you run.
recordings.summary: Opens the risk register, which ranks every risk by the number of model elements it reaches and names them. Following one named application opens its impact graph, showing what depends on it and what it depends on.
captions: See which risk would hit the most of your estate
The top risk reaches 56 elements of the model, and the register names them
8 things depend on this application, and it depends on 8
Three steps out it depends on 10 things, not 8: the full reach of a failure
